displayName: Cloud Function killed by the platform

documentation.content:
A Cloud Function instance was killed before its handler could return. The usual cause is an out-of-memory error; a timeout and a container crash produce the same class of message.

No reporter inside the process runs for this class, so Sentry holds nothing. That is why this policy exists. See docs/adr/0001-error-reporting-for-the-cloud-functions.md.

First step: open Cloud Logging with the filter from this policy, find the invocation, and read the function name off resource.labels.function_name. Then compare the function's memory metric against its runWith({ memory }) limit in functions/src.

conditions.displayName: A kill message in the log of a 1st gen function

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_function" severity>=ERROR (textPayload:"memory limit exceeded" OR textPayload:"Function invocation was interrupted" OR textPayload:"finished with status: 'connection error'")
